cargo_fuzz.reason: `cargo-fuzz` is not installed in the pinned image and libFuzzer requires a nightly toolchain; the offline, stable-1.99.0, single-container workflow cannot run it. A bounded deterministic in-container mutation fuzzer is used instead.

method: seeded mutation fuzzing from valid encodings (bit flips, byte overwrites, truncation, splicing, extreme length fields, zero runs)
result: no panic, abort, hang, or unbounded allocation observed in any iteration
